title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 042
review_goal: Differentiate alarm, album, and android variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Round alarm clock with two floating bells and short hands inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simpler round alarm clock without feet at the bottom.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the twin bell clock with bottom feet when that more classic silhouette is needed.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the bell arcs and clock hands but removes the lower feet found on the first alarm variant.

items.depicts_observation: Round record disc with one centered dot and one upper groove
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a round record style disc rather than a sleeve or folder shape.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the open album sleeve when the main shape should be a wide pocket.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a single round disc with one dot and one short curved groove near the top left.

items.depicts_observation: Open record sleeve with a flat top edge and wide pocket opening
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a record sleeve or open pocket shape rather than a round disc.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the round record disc when the icon should stay circular.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot forms a wide open sleeve with a straight top line instead of a circular disc.

items.depicts_observation: Robot head and body with two antennae inside a rounded shell
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the full android robot with body, eyes, and antennae.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the half head android when the lower body should not be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the full robot shell with eyes, antennae, and a rounded lower body.

items.depicts_observation: Half android head with two antennae and a flat lower edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants only the android head cap without the full body below it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the full android robot when a rounded lower body should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot crops the android robot to a half dome head with two eyes and antennae.
